head: 8467f01
summary: Second confirmation on 8467f01. git diff --stat 1430d42 8467f01 -- cabin777/src touches only 04_shaders.js, 12_scene.js and 07_shell.js (4 lines, the window lip albedo). 10_mono.js and 05_layout.js are unchanged, so monument geometry, materials and atlas are identical to the 8.7 head. Old_r vs new: |dL|>8 is 0.00 % in q01, q11, q19, m01, m03, m06, m09 and m12, 0.10 % in m05, 0.21 % in q13 and 1.86 % in m02. The m02 change is the left sidewall window reveal (shell, not monuments) and the m05 change is the window glimpse past the bar cheek. Luminance on every monument surface is unchanged. The hue change (|dB-R|>8: q19 22.7 %, m12 25.1 %, m09 11.2 %, q13 22.2 %) is the intended removal of the L14 lavender cast: it falls only on the door-4/5 galley lower faces, the J/PY partition's lower half and the PY seats, and in every case it moves B-R back towards neutral. The routed medium is fixed. Probe (white L>140, 60-85 % vs 20-45 % of frame height): q19 +7.1/-3.6 -> -4.6/-3.6, m12 +7.5/-6.2 -> -5.0/-6.2, m09 +5.3/-6.6 -> -2.6/-6.6. q19 and m12 are within 1.2 of each other. m09 has a 4.0 gap, but that is the pre-L14 5e5e561 baseline (-2.5/-7.6, a 5.1 gap) and a material difference: the white lower panel at -3 sits against the grey stowage inserts at -8. It is no longer a lighting split. The q19 x605-640 column no longer jumps from -1 to +9..+11 at about 1.3 m: it now reads -1 down to row 325, then +5/+6 at the counter edge, then -8 on the cart faces, which matches the inserts' -7. There is no new artefact on monument surfaces: the bar (m05/m06/q11), the welcome galley (m03), the door-1 galley (m01) and the F front wall (m02 apart from the window) are pixel-identical. The new fCut/jzS/lookOut terms do not reach the monuments in these views. The carried lows re-measure exactly as before. The score holds at 8.7. There is no high or medium issue.
lighting_note: Not scored. (1) FIXED: the L14 lavender cast on the door-4/5 galley lower faces. seatC and bleed are now multiplied by sz (the window LUT seat-zone row) and bleed by albedo neutrality. Measured B-R p50 old -> new: q19 below-counter wall +11 -> -3, q19 left carts +8 -> +5, m09 lower white panel +7 -> -3 (inserts -7, unchanged), m12 lower half +8 -> -3, m12 cart faces (x380-550, rows 450-525) +7 -> -8. The J/PY partition in q13 (x670-730) loses its lavender lower half: rows 240-330 go from +14..+21 to +3/+4, which matches its upper rows (+2/+3). L is unchanged everywhere (|dL|<=1). (2) Small residual, low: the door-4/5 cart faces now sit slightly cool (B-R -8, L about 197) against the upper wall (-1..-5). This is within 3-4 of the galley inserts and reads as cool-neutral white, not lavender. The photos' galley whites are neutral to slightly warm, so it is optional to touch. (3) Carried, unchanged: the bar's open bays are crushed to L3 (j32 about L11), the black soffit sits over the bar, the counter in m05 shows no reflections, and the q11 ash doors run bright (exposure).
